On this walk you understand Mughal courtly life and architecture through a palace-fort.

The date, start time, pace and language are arranged to suit your group.

What it covers

  • Lahori Gate and entrance
  • Chhatta Chowk/Naubat Khana
  • Diwan-i-Aam/Diwan-i-Khas areas
  • Water and pavilions

How the time is spent

  1. Lahori Gate and entrance 20 min

    Explain Shahjahanabad and citadel entry.

    You: map procession

  2. Chhatta Chowk/Naubat Khana 50 min

    Discuss markets, royal ceremony and circulation.

    You: mark sequence

  3. Diwan-i-Aam/Diwan-i-Khas areas 45 min

    Read public/private court politics as accessible.

    You: compare plans

  4. Water and pavilions 20 min

    Interpret Nahr-i-Behisht and material conservation.

    You: architectural sketch

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

By the end you can

  • Identify and interpret key features of Red Fort Complex using material evidence and a site map.
  • Understand Mughal courtly life and architecture through a palace-fort.
  • Distinguish directly visible fabric from reconstructed or debated historical claims.

You take away

Your annotated field card, sketches and notes.

Old Delhi
